message: Setsugekka and Asahi finished their mutual practice drills, and it was time for a break.
We have more practice scheduled for later today, so I guess I'll just wait here for now.

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji, how have things been with Miyako lately？」
I call out to Momiji, who is sitting nearby.

name: Momiji
message: 「Miyako？ She’s not as much trouble as I thought she’d be~」
A few days have passed since Miyako first arrived at the academy. She only showed up in the classroom on the first day, and I haven't seen her face since.

name: Momiji
message: 「It’s been like that for a long time, but Miyako is just one of those kids who can do everything on her own.」

name: Momiji
message: 「She says she’s bored of just watching the lessons, so it seems she’s just wandering around the academy by herself.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I don’t even know what she’s actually up to.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha, she’s certainly free-spirited.」

name: Momiji
message: 「She’s the very definition of a lone wolf. Honestly, Miyako might be the most well-suited for the Suzakuin family.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I really wish she’d just take over the Suzakuin house for me.」

name: Iori
message: 「Miyako’s dream is to conquer the world, you know.」

name: Momiji
message: 「W-well, once she grows up and learns how the real world works, she’ll probably mellow out a bit. A little bit of mischief never hurt, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「You really don’t want to become the head of the family that much?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Do you really think I want to take on such a troublesome task as carrying the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association on my back and leading all those martial families？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, absolutely not.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Exactly.」

name: Momiji
message: 「That’s why, even though Keisetsu is working so hard to become the head, I can’t help but think... are you out of your mind...?」

name: Iori
message: 「The Kazamine and Suzakuin families really are polar opposites in so many ways.」
It must be tough, carrying the burden of such famous names.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haaaaahhh...」
Just then, Setsugekka, who also carries such a burden, came walking over.

name: Iori
message: 「What’s wrong, Setsugekka?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Teacher, am I really getting stronger?」

name: Iori
message: 「Judging by the numbers, you’re doing much better than before. Are you worried about losing your practice matches？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes... Everyone seems to be moving ahead so quickly. I wonder if I can really become a Toujinegi...」
There are less than two months left until the Martial Festival. It’s a period when anyone would start to feel impatience and anxiety.

name: Iori
message: 「You’ve been handling the rigorous basic training well and working hard.」

name: Iori
message: 「For a fencer like you, Setsugekka, who moves all over the field to fight, muscular strength and stamina are significantly more important than for others.」

name: Iori
message: 「In that regard, your physique has been steadily leveling up compared to before.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「And yet, I still can’t win our sparring sessions.」

name: Iori
message: 「Right, but it might take some time before that translates into results.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「How long is ‘some time’ exactly！？」
Setsugekka’s bottleneck is her low psychical sensitivity value.
To compensate for that, it is essential to utilize the secret art 《Tamukai》, but…
I reached out through my acquaintances to ask around about cases where a Saniwa was able to unleash their power without losing control.

name: Iori
message: （Well, I did get some answers, but they’re all pretty vague…）
Still, it might be worth a shot.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, Setsugekka. Come with me for a moment.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What is it？ Did you find a good method！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, there’s something I want you to try.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm, can I tag along too？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Of course you can’t！ Are you trying to peek at the secret training between me and Muragaki-sensei?」

name: Iori
message: 「No, it’s fine. You can come along.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehhh！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Heh, score!」
I brought the two of them to the indoor training facility.

name: Iori
message: 「Phew, glad the facility was free.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Muragaki-sensei, what are we doing here？」

name: Iori
message: 「I want you to spar against this Yorishiro-kun.」
I operate the simulator to call forth an opponent.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehhhhh, m-me！？」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s right, you.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-Why do I have to fight myself？」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, let's just give it a try for now」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Y-Yes...」
Waiting until Setsugekka finishes getting ready, I start up the simulator.

name: Yorishiro-kun
message: 「Combat simulation will now commence」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I don't really get it, but... here I go~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Take this, Mishima-ryuu Type Hinoe: Ugachibi！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa... T-Type Kanoe: Gouhou, huh」

name: Iori
message: 「How is it, Setsugekka? Fighting yourself」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uuu~, this is so hard to fight against」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「My range and my opponent's range are the exact same, so it's super nerve-wracking~！」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, I bet」
Setsugekka exchanges several more blows.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Why you... Your body's wide open, hey~！」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, that's your own opening. Make sure you realize that you normally don't keep your arms tucked in tight enough」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh... Guhh, this is getting even harder to fight~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I mean, what's even the point of this！？」

name: Iori
message: 「The Yorishiro-kun you're fighting right now is Setsugekka」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I can tell just by looking！」

name: Iori
message: 「That's not what I mean. I don't want you to just look—I want you to feel it」

name: Iori
message: 「The you who's fighting, the you who faces your opponent. Through fighting yourself, I want you to view your own inner self objectively」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「View my own inner self objectively...？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that's right. Think carefully, Setsugekka」

name: Iori
message: 「Who you really are, what it is you desire. Why you are alive, and what you are living for」

name: Iori
message: 「Look at yourself standing right before your own eyes, and get to know yourself even better.」
Through a friend's connection, I was able to hear from a certain exorcist.
How to control a god―it is this―

name: Iori
message: 「Gods always lend a hand to sincere wishes. The only thing that draws a wish to oneself is one's own will.」

name: Iori
message: 「In other words, it’s about knowing yourself—knowing yourself better than anyone else. That builds a strong self capable of standing on equal footing with a god.」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, you need to know yourself better.」

name: Iori
message: 「When you feel joy, when you feel anger, when you feel sadness, and when you feel happiness.」

name: Iori
message: 「Delve deeper, right down to the root of your inner self. That will surely be useful when you commune with a god.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm… I-I don’t really get it!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But, I think I sort of understand.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That I really don't understand myself at all.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’m full of openings everywhere, I’ve got weird habits, and my gaze and expressions are so easy to read… I’m hopeless, aren’t I.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But when I think about *why* I’m like that, I realize—ah, I see.」

name: Iori
message: 「Good, Setsugekka. That realization is an important first step！」
Everyone thinks they know themselves best, yet in reality, there are times when they don't understand themselves at all.
That is because they are unable to view themselves objectively.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa, I feel like I’m getting closer to the answer!」

name: Iori
message: 「Keep at it, and keep communing with yourself！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Okay, I’ll give it a shot！」
Setsugekka shows sudden, renewed motivation.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Come on, come on—hey there, Kazamine Setsugekka！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Let’s cross our Origami and lay everything out on the table！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Right then, here I go！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Take that… don’t use such half-baked attacks on me！」

name: Yorishiro-kun
message: 「Barrier Jacket integrity has fallen below the safety threshold. Please terminate the combat simulation.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes! I took you down!」

name: Iori
message: 「Good work, Setsugekka. Shall we take a break?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes!」
I hand her a towel and commend Setsugekka as she returns.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Phew... That really cleared my head. It’s fresh and fun to spar with yourself, isn’t it~」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, checking your form in a mirror is fine, but this is much closer to a real fight.」

name: Iori
message: 「Besides, once you get used to it, I hope you can focus more on internal dialogue.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Understood!」
Setsugekka had been down before starting this training, but she’s regained a lot of her energy.

name: Momiji
message: 「That’s good for you, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, feeling like a fool for overthinking everything. I guess I’m better at moving than thinking, huh~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hey, Sensei, don't I get anything？」

name: Iori
message: 「You have zazen, don't you, Momiji?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, I’m sick of zazen already~!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Seriously, not thinking about anything at all is just agonizing.」

name: Iori
message: 「Is it really that agonizing？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Even just trying not to think for a minute is pretty rough.」

name: Iori
message: 「...I see. You’ve got a sharp mind, Momiji.」
For Momiji, whose mind is constantly racing, 'not thinking about anything' must be many times more painful than it is for a normal person.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s weird. I find it easier not to think about anything, though~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Must be nice... being so carefree. I’m genuinely envious.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s kinda annoying, you’re making fun of me, aren't you!」

name: Momiji
message: 「No, no, I seriously want to know. How do you go about not thinking？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Why are you asking me？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Because, Setsugekka, you don't even think when you're living your daily life anyway.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Don't mess with me, I think plenty when I'm living my life！」

name: Momiji
message: 「But it’s easier not to think about it, right？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, yeah, thinking about complicated stuff just makes my head hurt, and it’s happier to just do nothing and go powaa~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Right there, that ‘powaa~’ thing, tell me more about it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh? What do you mean ‘more about it’? Powaa~ is just powaa~.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Show me by actually doing it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I-I guess that’s fine, but…」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Powaa~……」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Is this good？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Can you do it one more time?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Powaa~, powawa~……」

name: Iori
message: 「Pfft……」
Seeing Setsugekka’s blissed-out expression, I couldn't help but burst out laughing.

name: Momiji
message: 「She’s just a total airhead.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, come on, that’s enough, you know！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「And why are you laughing too, Sensei！？ That’s rude, isn’t it！？」

name: Iori
message: 「S-sorry. I didn't mean any harm, forgive me.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What’s the deal? You just wanted to diss me, didn't you?」
Setsugekka fumed in annoyance.

name: Momiji
message: 「Sorry, sorry. I just want to know how to do that ‘powaa~’ thing.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What do you mean ‘how’? Can’t you just try making the same face?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Come on, Momimomi, try imitating me.」

name: Momiji
message: 「O-okay.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Powaa~……」

name: Momiji
message: 「Powaa~」

name: Iori
message: 「Bfff……」
No good, it hit my funny bone.

name: Momiji
message: 「Sorry, no way. This is just too embarrassing.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Are you saying that I’m some kind of embarrassing creature!?」

name: Momiji
message: 「No, I mean, seriously, it’s just too hard to not think about anything at all.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I honestly have no idea what’s so hard about it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I mean, just get plenty of sleep, eat something delicious, and gaze up at the sky—it’s easy, right?」

name: Momiji
message: 「I’m amazed you’ve managed to get by until now like that.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm... Well, in my case, Kei-chan does all the difficult thinking for me.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I could never just leave things up to someone else. I don’t understand how you can be satisfied with that.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kei-chan is kind, and she’s always on my side.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Plus, Kei-chan always finds a better answer than whatever I could come up with on my own.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Things always turn out way better when I just do what she suggests.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You know how they say, an amateur’s thinking is as good as sleeping, right?」

name: Momiji
message: 「‘An amateur’s thinking is like a waste of time,’ you mean.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, that. If I’m just going to stress over things I don’t understand forever, I think it’s better to just leave it to someone who can.」
Listening to Setsugekka, Momiji fell silent.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmph, I sense you’re looking down on me again!」

name: Momiji
message: 「I’m not. Hmm, I see.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What do you see?」

name: Momiji
message: 「No, just… the idea that it’s better to leave it to others than to stress over things you don’t understand… that’s actually kind of nice.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hm？ I just said what felt obvious to me.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, it isn’t obvious to me.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh, what do you mean？」

name: Iori
message: 「Doesn't it just mean she's too smart, and doesn't have anyone around she can entrust her problems to?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What's with that sarcasm? I hope you agonize over it and writhe in misery.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Don't put a curse on me!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, I might've gotten a bit of a hint, though.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm, well, that's good then.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Thanks, Secchan.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, don't sweat it!」
Thanks to Setsugekka, it seemed Momiji had grasped something too.
